sections.name: Six families, zero pasted SVG
sections.summary: Each card below is authored with only a dtype — no SVG in the source. std-doc looks the chart up in the library catalog (stddoc-lib/flint/) and embeds its pre-rendered, freeze-clean Vega-Lite SVG. This is the whole quantitative/statistical family D2 and Mermaid can't draw, available by NAME. All freeze browser-free (0 external refs).
